title: Deck with layouts missing from [Content_Types].xml shows real design
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. Reference deck good-16x9.pptx (python-pptx, 13.333x7.5 in, 5 slides): S1 title 'Design test' on white; S2 two pictures (red square PNG left, blue circle PNG right) with caption 'Two pictures'; S3 solid dark-blue background (#1E3A8A) with white title 'Blue background'; S4 full-slide picture background (yellow/green gradient PNG set as background fill or a full-slide picture sent to back) with title 'Picture background'; S5 formatted text: 'Bold' bold, 'Italic' italic, 'Red 40pt' in red 40 pt, and a 3-item bullet list. Damaged copy: unzip good-16x9.pptx, delete every <Override> for /ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayoutN.xml from [Content_Types].xml, re-zip (keep [Content_Types].xml first). File: dmg-ct-layouts.pptx.
steps: Wait for the deck tab to appear and slide 1 to draw
Step through slides 1-5 with the app's '›' button, looking at each slide
expected: Upload succeeds and the deck appears as a tab with 'Slide 1 / 5'. S2 shows both pictures (red square and blue circle) as images; S3 has a dark-blue background with white title; S4 shows the gradient picture behind the title; S5 shows bold, italic, red large text and bullets. the note 'This slide's design can't be shown here, so here is its text…' does NOT appear on any slide; no slide is blank.

title: Deck with relationship targets written as /ppt/... shows real design
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. Reference deck good-16x9.pptx (python-pptx, 13.333x7.5 in, 5 slides): S1 title 'Design test' on white; S2 two pictures (red square PNG left, blue circle PNG right) with caption 'Two pictures'; S3 solid dark-blue background (#1E3A8A) with white title 'Blue background'; S4 full-slide picture background (yellow/green gradient PNG set as background fill or a full-slide picture sent to back) with title 'Picture background'; S5 formatted text: 'Bold' bold, 'Italic' italic, 'Red 40pt' in red 40 pt, and a 3-item bullet list. Damaged copy: unzip good-16x9.pptx, in ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels and every ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels rewrite relative targets to absolute ones (e.g. '../slideLayouts/slideLayout2.xml' → '/ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout2.xml', '../media/image1.png' → '/ppt/media/image1.png', 'slides/slide1.xml' → '/ppt/slides/slide1.xml'), re-zip (keep [Content_Types].xml first). File: dmg-abs-targets.pptx.
expected: 'Slide 1 / 5' shown; all 5 slides drawn with their design: S2 pictures visible, S3 blue background, S4 picture background, S5 formatted text. No text-only note on any slide; slides appear in original order (S1 'Design test' … S5 formatted text).

title: Deck with relationship targets written as ./... shows real design
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. Damaged copy: unzip good-16x9.pptx, rewrite targets with a leading './' (presentation.xml.rels: 'slides/slide1.xml' → './slides/slide1.xml'; slide rels: '../slideLayouts/slideLayout2.xml' → './../slideLayouts/slideLayout2.xml', '../media/image1.png' → './../media/image1.png'), re-zip (keep [Content_Types].xml first). expected: 'Slide 1 / 5' shown; pictures (S2), blue background (S3), picture background (S4) and formatted text (S5) are drawn. No text-only note; no blank slide.

title: Combined damage (content types + /ppt/ + ./ targets, masters/themes missing from content types)
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. expected: 'Slide 1 / 5'; all 5 slides drawn with pictures, backgrounds and formatted text, in order. No text-only note. Console may show '[slides]' diagnostic warnings but no uncaught errors (red exceptions).

title: Formatted text and background picture match the undamaged reference
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. Decks good-16x9.pptx and dmg-ct-layouts.pptx (see TC-01) both uploaded to the class as separate tabs.

Open the dmg-ct-layouts tab, go to slide 4, then slide 5, take screenshots
Compare the pairs side by side
expected: For both slides the damaged deck looks the same as the reference: S4 gradient picture fills the slide behind the title; S5 'Bold' is bold, 'Italic' is italic, 'Red 40pt' is red and visibly larger, bullets show bullet markers and indentation. No plain-text fallback block.

title: LibreOffice-exported deck with pictures, coloured background and formula
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. Deck lo-formula.pptx: in LibreOffice Impress (or a .fodp/.odp made by script) create 3 slides: S1 a picture (red square PNG) + caption; S2 slide background colour orange (#F97316) with title 'Orange'; S3 Insert → Object → Formula with 'E = mc^2' and 'x = {-b +- sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}} over {2a}' (alternatively a python-pptx deck with an OMML equation inserted via raw XML). expected: 'Slide 1 / 3'. S1 shows the red picture; S2 has an orange background with title 'Orange'; S3 shows the formula either drawn, as its picture, or as its text (e.g. 'E = mc²' / the quadratic formula). S3 is never blank and shows no error message; no page error in the console.

title: 32-slide repaired deck: count, order, arrows and counters
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. Deck recitation-32.pptx (Recitation9 stand-in): python-pptx 32 slides, each with big title 'Slide k of 32' and a different background colour, slide 10 with a picture; round-tripped through `soffice --convert-to pptx`, then damaged (layout Overrides removed from [Content_Types].xml and slide rels rewritten to '/ppt/...').
steps: Read the app counter and the library's in-slide 'N/M' counter
Press the library's small next arrow inside the slide once
expected: Initially app counter 'Slide 1 / 32' and in-slide counter '1/32'; slide shows 'Slide 1 of 32'. After 3× '›': 'Slide 4 / 32' and the title reads 'Slide 4 of 32'. Library arrow advances to 5 and the app counter follows ('Slide 5 / 32'). After 2× '‹': 'Slide 3 / 32'. Last slide shows 'Slide 32 of 32' and 'Slide 32 / 32'; '›' is disabled or does nothing. Every viewed slide shows its colour background (design, not text-only note); slide 10 shows its picture.

title: Slide jump lands on the correct slide in a repaired deck
preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open. recitation-32.pptx (see TC-08) uploaded.
steps: Use the slide jump (click the 'Slide N / 32' control / enter slide number) to go to slide 20
Try an out-of-range value (e.g. 40 or 0) if the control accepts typing
expected: Jump to 20 shows title 'Slide 20 of 32' with its design and counters 'Slide 20 / 32' and '20/32'. Jumps to 1 and 32 show the matching slides. Out-of-range input is ignored or clamped (no blank slide, no error).

title: Bookmarks work on a repaired deck

Open the dropdown again and choose slide 21
Reload the page and reopen the deck tab and the dropdown
expected: Dropdown lists slide 7 and slide 21. Choosing slide 7 shows title 'Slide 7 of 32' and 'Slide 7 / 32'; choosing 21 shows 'Slide 21 of 32' and 'Slide 21 / 32'. Bookmarks remain after reload (as with mocked backend persistence) and still point to the right slides.

preconditions: Signed in (fake session, mocked backend), enrolled in a test class, class page open with the Slides panel visible, browser DevTools console open.
